title: Ventilate During Best Air Window
description: Open windows for brief cross-ventilation only during the lowest-PM2.5 hours, and close up before evening inversion.
whyItWorks: Cross-ventilation flushes trapped indoor CO2 and cooking fumes while minimizing outdoor PM2.5 infiltration.
effectRange: 20–40% lower indoor PM2.5 vs. random window opening

title: Seal & Close Windows During High-PM2.5 Hours
description: Keep exterior windows and balcony doors shut when PM2.5 exceeds 60 µg/m³; place a rolled damp cloth at leaky door gaps.
whyItWorks: Reduces outdoor fine particulate infiltration during traffic and evening inversion peaks.

title: Avoid Indoor Incense, Agarbatti & Mosquito Coils
description: Pause indoor burning of incense sticks, dhoop, and mosquito coils; switch to electric vaporizers or window screens.
whyItWorks: Eliminates major indoor combustion spikes (60–100+ µg/m³ PM2.5 plus VOCs) inside closed rooms.
effectRange: 30–100 µg/m³ peak PM2.5 avoided per room

title: Wet Mop Instead of Dry Sweeping
description: Replace dry brooming with damp/wet mopping and microfiber dusting to avoid kicking settled dust back into the air.
whyItWorks: Dry sweeping re-suspends coarse and fine settled dust; wet cleaning traps particles on the cloth.

title: Run Chimney or Exhaust Fan While Cooking
description: Switch on the kitchen chimney/exhaust fan 2 minutes before lighting the stove and keep it running 10 minutes after.
whyItWorks: Captures combustion NO2 and cooking oil aerosols at the source before they drift into living spaces.

title: Cover Pots & Pans While Cooking
description: Use tight-fitting lids while boiling or simmering to trap steam, shorten cooking time, and cut cooking fumes.
whyItWorks: Reduces fuel burned by 25–30% and lowers aerosolized cooking oil/moisture droplets.
effectRange: 25–30% lower cooking fuel & reduced kitchen aerosols

title: Set AC to 24–26°C (With Recirculation Mode)
description: Set AC temperature to 26°C and keep fresh-air intake closed during smoggy hours to save power and reduce infiltration.
whyItWorks: Each 1°C increase above 22°C trims compressor electricity by ~6% (BEE India) and keeps outdoor smog out.

title: Switch Off Standby Loads at Wall Socket
description: Turn off set-top boxes, chargers, microwaves, and monitors at the wall overnight.
whyItWorks: Cuts phantom standby draw that accounts for 5–10% of typical urban household electricity.

title: Batch Errands & Avoid Peak-Traffic Idling
description: Combine short motorized errands into one trip during lower-traffic hours and turn off engines at long signals.
whyItWorks: Fewer cold starts and less traffic idling reduces both fuel burn and personal roadside PM2.5 inhalation.
effectRange: 10–20% lower local trip emissions & lower roadside dose

title: Work From Home on Severe-Smog Days
description: Shift 1–2 commute days per week to remote work when feasible, especially during Poor/Very Poor AQI alerts.
whyItWorks: Eliminates commute tailpipe emissions and cuts high-dose roadside pollution exposure on peak days.

title: Carpool on Regular Office Routes
description: Share solo car trips with 1–3 colleagues traveling the same corridor.
whyItWorks: Divides per-person fuel consumption and tailpipe CO2e by the number of occupants.

title: Shift 2–3 Weekly Meals to Plant-Forward
description: Swap meat-heavy dishes for dal, legumes, millets, and seasonal vegetables a few times each week.
whyItWorks: Plant proteins carry substantially lower life-cycle GHG emissions than meat-heavy diets.

title: Prefer Local & Seasonal Produce
description: Choose regional seasonal vegetables and fruits rather than cold-chain or air-freighted items.
whyItWorks: Reduces refrigeration and long-haul transport energy per kg of food.

title: Plan Portions & Eliminate Kitchen Food Waste
description: Batch-plan meals and store leftovers promptly so edible food does not end up in anaerobic landfills.
whyItWorks: Prevents wasted embedded food production emissions and landfill methane generation.

title: Use Pressure Cooker for Pulses, Rice & Stews
description: Cook staples in a pressure cooker instead of open pots to halve cooking duration.
whyItWorks: Higher boiling pressure cooks 50–70% faster, proportionally cutting LPG/PNG burn and indoor heat/fumes.
effectRange: 40–60% lower fuel use for boiled dishes

title: Replace Remaining CFL/Incandescent Bulbs with LEDs
description: Swap older bulbs in high-use rooms with BEE-rated LED bulbs (estimate, verify locally).
whyItWorks: LEDs deliver equal lumen output using ~50–80% less wattage (~30 kWh/bulb/year saved vs CFL/older lamps).
effectRange: ~30 kWh/year saved per bulb (~25 kg CO2e)

title: Shift Commute Days to Metro / Rail
description: Replace solo car or two-wheeler trips with metro rail + short feeder walk/auto where lines exist.
whyItWorks: Electric rail per-passenger emissions (~0.015 kgCO2e/km) are 60–90% lower than private petrol vehicles.

title: Segregate Dry & Wet Waste at Home
description: Keep separate bins for dry recyclables, wet kitchen organics, and domestic hazardous waste.
whyItWorks: Prevents wet organics from mixing with recyclables and lowers landfill methane emissions by ~30%.

title: Start Balcony/Kitchen Wet-Waste Composting
description: Use an aerated terracotta or bin composter for kitchen scraps (estimate, verify locally).
whyItWorks: Aerobic composting avoids anaerobic landfill methane generation and produces garden compost.

title: Switch to Low-VOC Fragrance-Free Cleaners
description: Replace aerosol sprays and harsh scented cleaners with mild liquid soap, vinegar, or baking soda.
whyItWorks: Cuts indoor volatile organic compound (VOC) vapors that irritate airways when windows are shut.
effectRange: Lower indoor VOC peaks during closed-window days

title: Build a MERV-13 DIY Box-Fan Air Cleaner
description: Pair a box/square fan with MERV-13 panel filters sealed with tape as a budget clean-room filter (estimate, verify locally).
whyItWorks: Validated in lab studies (UC Davis / PNAS) to remove 60–70% of indoor PM2.5 at low upfront cost.
effectRange: 60–70% indoor PM2.5 reduction in sealed room

title: Add an Induction Cooktop for Daily Boiling & Frying
description: Use a single/dual-zone induction stove with compatible flat cookware alongside or replacing LPG (estimate, verify locally).
whyItWorks: Eliminates indoor gas combustion NO2, CO, and ultrafine particles while doubling thermal transfer efficiency (80–90% vs 40%).
effectRange: 50–70% lower kitchen cooking PM2.5 & net CO2e savings

title: Cycle for Short Trips Under 5 km (On Clean-Air Hours)
description: Use a bicycle for local errands when PM2.5 is Satisfactory/Good; skip cycling on Poor/Severe smog hours.
whyItWorks: Zero direct fuel emissions and health benefits when outdoor PM2.5 is low.
effectRange: 100% emissions cut on replaced vehicle trips

title: Place a Sized True-HEPA Purifier in the Clean Room
description: Run a True-HEPA H13 purifier sized to ≥5 air changes/hour in your sealed sleeping/clean room (estimate, verify locally).
whyItWorks: Cochrane-reviewed RCTs show portable HEPA units cut indoor PM2.5 by 50–80% when properly sized and kept closed.
effectRange: 50–80% lower indoor PM2.5 in the clean room

title: Choose BEE 5-Star Models Only When Replacing Old Appliances
description: Wait until existing working appliances reach end-of-life, then replace with BEE 5-star inverter models (keep working units!).
whyItWorks: Avoids premature embodied manufacturing waste while cutting future annual kWh by 20–30%.

title: Install a Roof Solar Water Heater (Owner Homes)
description: Replace heavy electric geyser heating loads with solar thermal heating where roof access exists (estimate, verify locally).
whyItWorks: Offsets 1,000–1,200 kWh/year of coal-heavy grid power with 2–4 year typical payback.

title: Indoor Plants (Decorative Only — Do Not Rely on Them for Smog)
description: Keep low-maintenance plants for greenery, but do not treat them as air purifiers during PM2.5 episodes.
whyItWorks: Peer-reviewed reviews (Cummings & Waring, 2020) show potted plants provide negligible PM2.5 removal compared to HEPA/ventilation.
